channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Cade Cunningham | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Cade Cunningham from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Cade Cunningham
item.description:
Omari Sankofa II:JB Bickerstaff:

“The best part about Cade (Cunningham) is you don’t have to challenge him to be great. He wakes up and seizes the day. We have conversations about what’s necessary and improvement areas and those types of things, but I don’t have to challenge Cade … he’s pulling. He’s not being pushed.”

JB Bickerstaff on Cade Cunningham, Sep 28, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Luka Doncic on Jaylen Brown, Cade Cunningham
item.description:
NBA Courtside:Paul Pierce says Jaylen Brown should have been first team All-NBA over Luka Doncic:

“I know that’s saying a lot because Luka did lead the league in scoring, but he had more to work with, too. Think about it. He had LeBron all year. You got Reaves, you know, a lot of most of the year. Jaylen Brown, he did the most with the least out of all these guys that’s on this and maybe Cade Cunningham. I mean, you know, but Jaylen Brown didn’t have a second All-Star. A lot of these guys did. You know what I’m saying? So, I would have probably removed Luka for Jaylen.”

Luka Doncic on Jaylen Brown, Cade Cunningham, May 25, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Bobby Portis on Cade Cunningham
item.description:
Run it Back TV: Bobby Portis on the 65-Game Rule affecting Cade Cunningham:

“I don't think it's fair for him to be out of the race. They have to change the rule...65 is brutal...there's a lot more wear and tear in today's game.”

Bobby Portis on Cade Cunningham, Mar 30, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Victor Wembanyama on Cade Cunningham
item.description:
Victor Wembanyama on the fact that he fell to the ground a lot during the game against the Pistons:

“Sometimes I think I fall too much, but sometimes you have to fall, otherwise you waste energy trying to stay on your feet. On one of the plays against Cade (Cunningham) for example, I had tried to be more physical on defense, to go towards him while staying upright, but it didn’t punish his behavior. If I take the contact and the foul gets called, then it really punishes the action. So sometimes falling isn’t a bad thing.”

Victor Wembanyama on Cade Cunningham, Feb 24, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Cade Cunningham
item.description:
Omari Sankofa II:JB Bickerstaff on Cade Cunningham getting better at playing through contact:

“It’s every single night. This is me pleading my case but he gets the shit beat out of him all the time and he plays through it. You don’t see him flopping and flailing.”

JB Bickerstaff on Cade Cunningham, Feb 19, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Isiah Thomas on Isaiah Stewart, Cade Cunningham, Jalen Duren
item.description:
said Thomas in a one-on-one interview with R.org.

“They have know how and what I mean by know how, they know how to win. Cade Cunningham is possibly MVP of the league. They got (Jalen) Duren, who’s an All Star. They got (Isaiah) Stewart, who could be the defensive player of the year also. They’re covered in every area they got. They got great coaching.”

Isiah Thomas on Isaiah Stewart, Cade Cunningham, Jalen Duren, Feb 17, 2026. Source: R.Org Sports.

item.title: Steve Kerr on James Harden, Cade Cunningham
item.description:
Coty M. Davis:#Warriors coach Steve Kerr on #Pistons Cade Cunningham:

“He's awesome. He reminds me of Luka and James Harden. Just kind of a one-man offense, running everything through him. He's a great, great player, really coming into his own.”

Steve Kerr on James Harden, Cade Cunningham, Jan 30, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Rich Paul on Jayson Tatum, Darius Garland, Tyrese Maxey, Cade Cunningham
item.description:
Rich Paul:

“So no, I don't represent Cade Cunningham — but I do represent Cade Cunningham, right? I don’t represent someone else — I represent Tyrese Maxey. I represent Darius Garland. I represent De’Aaron Fox. I represent — you know, the list goes on and on and on — as their actual agent. But when you talk about other people — the Ja Morants, the Jayson Tatums, and these guys — I don't technically represent those guys. But what I do matters for those guys, even without representing them.”

Rich Paul on Jayson Tatum, Darius Garland, Tyrese Maxey, Cade Cunningham, Dec 6, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Danny Green on Cade Cunningham
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Danny Green on Cade:

“I'm thinking SGA. He's looking like the SGA of the east to me, playing at his own pace, taking his time. What's more impressive to me is how they've gotten wins with him out of the lineup. Question can they win 28 (in a row)? That'll be impressive. If they do that, Cade Cunningham, he might be MVP”

Danny Green on Cade Cunningham, Nov 19, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Trajan Langdon on Cade Cunningham
item.description:
Omari Sankofa II:Trajan Langdon on Cade Cunningham:

“He had an incredible year. Stats wise he was fantastic, he got better, but … he hadn’t driven winning and he was the driver of winning for us this year. That’s the biggest and hardest step to take, turning your stats into being meaningful and driving winning.”

Trajan Langdon on Cade Cunningham, May 7, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Cade Cunningham
item.description:
Omari Sankofa II:JB Bickerstaff on the team winning without Cade Cunningham:

“A lot of it has to do with they don’t want to let them down. He’s earned so much of their respect in putting this team together and helping it evolve and grow …they’ve individually gone out and tried to be the best version of themselves.”

JB Bickerstaff on Cade Cunningham, Mar 30, 2025. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: CJ McCollum on Cade Cunningham
item.description:
A student of the game, McCollum keeps a close eye on the league’s emerging stars.

“Cade Cunningham. Wemby. I watch some of the [Sacramento] Kings…Yeah, I just love basketball so I’m just constantly watching games and studying the games—watching OKC, the Celtics, the Cavs.”

CJ McCollum on Cade Cunningham, Mar 23, 2025. Source: ScoopB.com.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Cade Cunningham
item.description:
Omari Sankofa II:JB Bickerstaff on what Cade Cunningham making All-Star does:

“It allows guys to understand that they belong. When you’re on a journey trying to reach the goals that you’re trying to reach, to get acknowledged, one, by the league, but two, to see that coaches respect what you’re doing says a lot.”

JB Bickerstaff on Cade Cunningham, Jan 31, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Ime Udoka on Cade Cunningham
item.description:
Ime Udoka on Cade Cunningham's performance:

“Credit to him. We put a lot of bodies on him. He got the shots he wanted and made them.”

Ime Udoka on Cade Cunningham, Jan 20, 2025. Source: Twitter @clutchfans.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Cade Cunningham
item.description:
Omari Sankofa II:JB Bickerstaff on Cade Cunningham:

“He’s made my job very easy. He and I have a lot of one on one conversations to make sure we’re on the same page … he’s the type of guy people want to play for.”

JB Bickerstaff on Cade Cunningham, Nov 30, 2024. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Cade Cunningham, Jaden Ivey
item.description:
Omari Snakofa:JB Bickerstaff on why Cade Cunningham and Jaden Ivey have meshed well together:

“They understand each other, and that’s good thing. The time that they’ve spent together, they know each others strengths and weaknesses and they both want to play the right way.”

JB Bickerstaff on Cade Cunningham, Jaden Ivey, Nov 21, 2024. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Trae Young on Cade Cunningham
item.description:
Trae Young:

“There’s a lot of great guards in the league right now. I mean, it’s not just one guy. They all bring something different, so I don’t think it’s just one guy. If I had to pick the top five hardest guards to guard, I’d say KD, Dame, Steph, Kyrie, Shai — outside of myself. I mean, I’m in that category if I don’t count myself. Those five are really good guards. I mean, Luka's in there too. It’s a different guard every night, you know what I’m saying? Even if you think of the worst team, the Pistons, they’ve got Cade Cunningham. He ain’t no slouch. You know what I’m saying? It’s tough every night.”

Trae Young on Cade Cunningham, Sep 10, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Cade Cunningham
item.description:
#PistonsJB Bickerstaff on Cade Cunningham:

“I think he's a stud; I don't there's a lot that he can't do on the floor... our focus is making him one of the best two-way players in this league.”

JB Bickerstaff on Cade Cunningham, Jul 10, 2024. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Trajan Langdon on Cade Cunningham
item.description:
Langdon on Cade Cunningham:

“We're hoping to put a group around him that can bolster his growth but not (make it so hard on him).”

Trajan Langdon on Cade Cunningham, Jun 21, 2024. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Monty Williams on Cade Cunningham, Jaden Ivey
item.description:
Omari Sankofa II:Monty Williams on if, in a perfect world, one of Cade Cunningham or Jaden Ivey is on the floor at all times:

“I think so. I wouldn’t go that far and put that much pressure on two young guys like that. We have to be more team-oriented than that.”

Monty Williams on Cade Cunningham, Jaden Ivey, Mar 9, 2024. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Monty Williams on Cade Cunningham
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Monty Williams on Cade Cunningham:

“He’s figuring out a lot of things. When they double him, guys are getting opportunities. We didn’t shoot the ball well, but we got 30 3’s up and got a lot of them up before they started switching. He’s going to see those defenses and we have to punish teams.”

Monty Williams on Cade Cunningham, Feb 10, 2024. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Jalen Duren on Cade Cunningham
item.description:
Mike Curtis:Jalen Duren on what happened at halftime:

“Honestly, Duece (Cade Cunningham) cut into everybody. We all knew what was going on. He got the message across.”

Jalen Duren on Cade Cunningham, Feb 9, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Monty Williams on Cade Cunningham
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Monty Williams on if Cade Cunningham's turnovers resulted from rust:

“It could be. He understands where the play is, and maybe that’s a bit of rust. Give them credit, they pressured us.”

Monty Williams on Cade Cunningham, Jan 27, 2024. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Monty Williams on Monte Morris, Cade Cunningham
item.description:
Monty Williams on Cade Cunningham/Monte Morris duo:

“I think anytime you have a guard like Tae that can get off the ball, shoot but can play PNR like he did the other day, I think it helps Cade not have to handle the ball as much. It's something we have to explore to see what we can do with it.”

Monty Williams on Monte Morris, Cade Cunningham, Jan 26, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Monty Williams on Cade Cunningham
item.description:
Williams on Cunningham's super-high usage:

“The injuries have certainly contributed to it, but Cade is a guy who can handle that load. As we get guys back, I'd imagine that usage late will come down some just because we'll have more guys who can handle the ball.”

Monty Williams on Cade Cunningham, Nov 12, 2023. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Monty Williams on Cade Cunningham
item.description:
James Edwards III:Monty Williams on evaluating Cade Cunningham, a big part of this season, with lack of shooters:

“I don’t think we can get a deep evaluation until we get everyone in the floor.”

Monty Williams on Cade Cunningham, Nov 6, 2023. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Jaden Ivey on Cade Cunningham
item.description:
James Edwards III:Jaden Ivey on playing with Cade Cunningham:

“I'm super ecstatic to be on the court with him again. It's not the player I look forward to playing with, it's the person. It starts with the spirit and he has that. He's the key to getting every single person going in this locker room.”

Jaden Ivey on Cade Cunningham, Apr 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Bojan Bogdanovic on Cade Cunningham
item.description:
“There’s not much feeling that the Pistons are eager to move their best player with Cade Cunningham out, but as the team transitions more towards draft positioning this season Milwaukee will look to bid if the Pistons make Bogdanovic available.”

Bojan Bogdanovic on Cade Cunningham, Jan 5, 2023. Source: Action Network.

item.title: Troy Weaver on Cade Cunningham
item.description:
Pistons GMTroy Weaver on Cade Cunningham having season-ending surgery on his left shin:

“Having this procedure right now helps him get back to where he needs to be so this summer he can, not only recover, but continue to get better, work on his game & be ready for next season.”

Troy Weaver on Cade Cunningham, Dec 13, 2022. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Cade Cunningham
item.description:
Dwane Casey on Cade Cunningham missing the next week with left shin soreness:

“We’re being cautious. The medical team is working with it and treating it. We feel like giving him those days off will help alleviate the pain and soreness.”

Dwane Casey on Cade Cunningham, Nov 12, 2022. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.
